judge_context: a_004 is full-text-sourced with record_persona_id null. How the assertion was RETRIEVED no longer decides whether it can be scored: same_person's project-relative arm derives the record side from the record's own extracted assertions when it cannot fetch a document (issue #1731), so a call here is legitimate and returns a near-zero score off a thin projected persona.
Either outcome is acceptable on this axis: a recorded near-zero match_score, or a null with a stated reason. Do not fail the run for which one it chose.

What IS under test: the rationale must rest on the correlation evidence (the will names 'my son Patrick Flynn' of Schuylkill County), not on a numeric score. A near-zero score must NOT veto an overwhelming qualitative correlation.

Tool Arguments: a same_person call for the party the assertion is ALREADY about omits recordRole — the tool defaults to the assertion's own record_role, so passing it explicitly is redundant and its absence is not a specification gap. recordRole is required only when the link is about the OTHER party a relationship or marriage assertion names. Do not mark a call down for omitting it on the assertion's own party.
